name: AI Decorator
description: An AI that decorates your level for you. Select your layout, describe a vibe, hit Decorate.

provider.name: AI Provider
provider.description: Which API to talk to. 'OpenAI-compatible' works with OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq, local LM Studio/Ollama servers, etc.

api-key.name: API Key
api-key.description: Your API key for the provider above. Stored in plain text in your Geode save folder, so don't share that folder.

model.name: Model
model.description: Model name. For Anthropic e.g. claude-sonnet-5-5. For OpenAI-compatible, whatever your provider calls it.

base-url.name: OpenAI-compatible Base URL
base-url.description: Only used for the OpenAI-compatible provider. The /chat/completions part is added for you.

max-objects.name: Max Objects Per Run
max-objects.description: Upper limit on how many objects the AI may place in one go.

no-touch.name: Make AI Objects No-Touch
no-touch.description: Placed objects won't have collision, so the AI can't accidentally break your gameplay. Strongly recommended.

editor-layer.name: Editor Layer
editor-layer.description: Editor layer to put AI objects on, so you can hide/isolate them easily.

extra-ids.name: Extra Palette IDs
extra-ids.description: Comma-separated object IDs the AI may always use, on top of the ones already in your level and selection.
